title: Copper Enhance
description: A little copper enhancing datapack for new java snapshot
body:
# Copper Armor Enhancement Datapack
Bring new life to the copper armor from the latest Minecraft snapshot! This datapack turns your copper gear into a high-voltage power system - complete with energy storage and lightning attacks.
## 🔋 Battery Armor System
Each copper armor piece now stores electric charge, with capacity depending on how many copper ingots were used to craft it:
| Armor Piece | Capacity |
|-------------|----------|
| 🪖Helmet   | 50       |
| 🦺Chestplate | 80     |
| 👖Leggings   | 70     |
| 🥾Boots      | 50     |
| Total        | 240⚡  |
## ⚔️ Lightning Blade
If you're wearing at least one charged copper armor piece and attack a mob with the copper sword, a lightning bolt will strike your target, as long as it's not an instant kill. One charge is consumed per lightning strike.
## ⚙️ Creative Mode Support
In Creative Mode, you can instantly fully charge your armor using:

```
/function copper:full_charge
```
## 🧪 Version Compatibility
- Vanilla-friendly
- Works with the latest Minecraft snapshot with copper armor
